description: Only for a coding agent on the owner's machine, such as Claude Code or Codex, sending a block that its own Superstables CLI signed and whose agent key and records stay on that machine. A chat app is refused: never ask the owner to paste a signed block into a chat. Without such a block, don't call this tool or build the block yourself. Sends a budget request that the CLI signed with --sign-only to superstables.com for the owner's approval. Pass the CLI's JSON block unchanged: method, path, headers and body. Superstables checks the agent's signature over that exact request, so it can't be changed here, and refuses a request sent twice or after its time window. A request to add an agent must use owner proof version 2. Returns the request id, the owner's approval link, the match code, when the link expires and the wallets of the account the request is on. Nothing changes until the owner approves with their wallet on superstables.com.

body.description: The request body exactly as the CLI printed it; any change fails the signature

headers.description: The four agent proof headers, as the CLI printed them

name: submit_budget_request
